headline: One detained after businessman shot inside shop in Shonir Akhra
summary: Aslam Khan, owner of Lucky Crockeries, was shot in the face and arm by attackers who entered his store in Dhaka.
details: A businessman named Aslam Khan, 40, was shot inside his shop, Lucky Crockeries, in the Shonir Akhra area of Dhaka on Saturday night.
The incident occurred around 8:30 PM in front of Royal Hospital under the Kadamtali police station. Two individuals entered the store, and one opened fire on the victim.
Aslam Khan sustained gunshot wounds to the right side of his face and above his left elbow. He was rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where he is currently receiving treatment.
Local residents managed to detain one of the suspects as they attempted to flee the scene and handed him over to the police. The second assailant managed to escape.
The victim's friend, Anwar Hossain, stated that the motive behind the shooting is not yet known. Police have been notified and are investigating the matter.
caption:
A businessman was shot in the face and arm inside his own shop in Dhaka's Shonir Akhra. One suspect has been detained.

A businessman named Aslam Khan, 40, was shot inside his shop, Lucky Crockeries, in the Shonir Akhra area of Dhaka on Saturday night.

The incident occurred around 8:30 PM in front of Royal Hospital under the Kadamtali police station. Two individuals entered the store, and one opened fire on the victim.

Aslam Khan sustained gunshot wounds to the right side of his face and above his left elbow. He was rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where he is currently receiving treatment.

Local residents managed to detain one of the suspects as they attempted to flee the scene and handed him over to the police. The second assailant managed to escape.

The victim's friend, Anwar Hossain, stated that the motive behind the shooting is not yet known. Police have been notified and are investigating the matter.

headline_marked: 3 arrested after [[body dumped on Elevated Expressway]]
headline: 3 arrested after body dumped on Elevated Expressway
summary: Police and RAB have detained a bus driver, supervisor, and helper following the discovery of a man's body on the Dhaka Elevated Expressway.
details: Police and RAB have arrested three people, including a bus driver, in connection with the discovery of a body on the Dhaka Elevated Expressway in Banani.
The joint operation took place in Mohakhali on Saturday, where authorities seized a bus that operates on the Dhaka-Jamalpur route.
The arrested individuals have been identified as driver Sohel Rana (40), supervisor Saju (28), and helper Monir (18).
The victim, identified as Ismail Hossain (50), was found on Friday morning in the Banani area with scotch tape on his mouth.
Ismail was a resident of Hobdesh village in Jamalpur Sadar, but lived with his family in the Kashimpur Korlapara area of Gazipur.
He had been reported missing before his body was recovered from the expressway.
